name: Invoker-Render 1.0 (Code World Model 2.0)
purpose: Proxy-conditioned video rendering for Code World Model 2.0: an upstream engine keeps the world state, visual proxies fix camera path, scene layout and object motion, and the video model generates the appearance, as an unbounded streaming session (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 and CC BY-NC 4.0 (card metadata: license other, apache-2.0-and-cc-by-nc-4.0)
license.notes: Card states the repository is subject to Apache-2.0 and CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial) terms; the license_link points to an acknowledgements section of the GitHub repository, which could not be read (raw README of the GitHub repo returned 404 / empty). Which files fall under which license is not stated on the card, so commercial use is treated as no. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: causal streaming diffusion transformer (config identifier MiniMaxH3Transformer3DModel), four-step streaming generation, built on MiniMax-H3
architecture.why_this_design: Card: a fixed appearance anchor and a bounded history window let a session run for as long as proxy frames arrive.

variants.notes: root weights about 132.5 GB (card) in 29 shards plus bidirectional_lora/teacher-live.safetensors 2.48 GB (a LoRA of the bidirectional teacher on MiniMax-H3, not to be applied to the root weights); VAE, Qwen text model, causal decoder and a prepared inference bundle are not included

pc-12gb.notes: 33.12B parameters; the vendor's default production profile uses eight NVIDIA GPUs on one node

mac-64gb+.notes: even a 4-bit copy of 33B parameters would not leave room for the streaming workload at video speed; no quantization exists

other: companion CodeWorldModel inference code (SGLang, SGLang-Omni, MiniMax-H3)

strengths: Long-horizon streaming with multi-granularity control (semantic maps, 3D boxes, subject masks, shaded geometry, skeletons)
weaknesses: Inputs 1344x768 first image and 24 FPS proxy video with 17*N+5 frames

tona_fit.reason: A 33B video world-model renderer for an eight-GPU node; it has no role for a local coding worker and fits no hardware class.

open_questions: Exact license split between Apache-2.0 and CC BY-NC 4.0: GitHub acknowledgements section not read
Quality evidence: the card gives no benchmark; the paper (arXiv 2611.22925) was not read
